messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment v1.12.3 promoted to prod (us-west-2) at 11:01 UTC
maya: noticed an SSE streaming tail latency spike right after the deploy, p99 +45ms, p50 +8ms. Traffic spike? nope. started ~11:02
priya: yep, graphs show spike for /v1/stream/generate across models. No error rate change, just latency
maya: timeline matches new serialization patch merged in PR #9087 — that touched toolcall frame packing + kernel selection heuristics
rafael: CI perf smoke flagged something in that PR but maintainer marked as flaky and merged — can we bisect?
oliver: starting bisect now. running `git bisect start -- bad v1.12.3 good v1.12.2 && git bisect run ./scripts/perf-smoke.sh`
ci-bot: perf-smoke: failure at commit 1f4a9b2 (batcher: prefer matmul-kernel-v2 for short sequences) — p99 latency regressed 38% in the SSE benchmark
oliver: confirmed locally on a small reproducer. Reproducer: `./bench/sse_latency --seq 32 --concurrency 8` before: p99 120ms, after: p99 170ms
perf-bot: flamegraph (snippet):
```
serialize_toolcall_frame  40%
select_kernel            25%
memcpy                   18%
sse_flush                10%
other                    7%
```
priya: interesting — select_kernel spike suggests kernel-selection now picks a path that forces an extra copy for SSE frames. That extra memcpy + serialization becomes visible in streaming small-chunk workloads
maya: the change in PR touched both batching heuristics and the kernel fallback table. Might be a subtle interaction with continuous-batching + SSE framing
rafael: agree. The kernel choice favors matmul-v2 for seq<=64 which assumes contiguous inputs; SSE framing uses scattered frames and requires an align/copy step. Not accounted for
jen: rolling back the kernel-selection tweak in canary now. `kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime --to-revision=stable-1.12.2-canary`
deploy-bot: Canary rollback started for runtime (canary-12) at 11:18 UTC
maya: after rollback to the old kernel-selection, SSE p99 back to ~118ms, p50 baseline. Monitoring now for 10m
oliver: creating follow-up: add synthetic SSE microbench to CI that exercises toolcall + streaming with seq=8..64, ensure no p99 regressions >10% from baseline. Also add kernel-selection unit test for scattered inputs
priya: opened issue #2345 with repro + bisect notes + recommended revert commit (1f4a9b2).cc @perf-bot please schedule perf test on next PR
perf-bot: scheduled perf-run on master and will post results in thread
jen: thanks all — pushing hotfix revert to prod after canary stabilizes. please add notes to the release notes about the regression and the CI test we added
maya: ack. good catch team :thumbsup:
